dataset.population_policy: Exclude rows where resource_type == 'http_request'; benchmark remaining business events only.

common_chronological_cutoff.method: Use the latest provisional chronological 80/20 session cutoff so both session definitions share an evaluation start.

evaluation_method.session_leakage_check: Sessions crossing the cutoff are excluded; each retained session belongs to either training or evaluation.
evaluation_method.isolation_forest: Isolation Forest fitted on training rows only; higher negated decision_function scores mean more anomalous.
evaluation_method.directional_baseline: One-sided robust scores: shorter-than-usual gaps and higher rolling counts increase the score. Long gaps and low activity counts do not increase the score.
evaluation_method.thresholds: Training score quantiles at nominal 1%, 2%, and 5% tails. Held-out alert rates are measured, not forced to match.
evaluation_method.fixed_alert_budgets: Top-ranked 1%, 2%, and 5% of held-out rows, with stable row-order tie-breaking and explicit boundary tie counts.

interpretation: This is an exploratory unsupervised benchmark, not a security validation. There are no verified anomaly labels. Ranking overlap, anomaly scores, PSI, and alert rates do not establish precision, recall, F1, or malicious activity. The evaluation window may contain only a few active days; interpret results accordingly. Production models and the existing risk report are not modified.
